# Amore Atelier

> Bespoke wedding signage and day-of stationery studio in Los Cabos, Baja California Sur, Mexico. Founded by Dariana & Aldo.

Amore Atelier designs, hand-crafts, and installs custom wedding signage and day-of stationery for destination weddings and wedding planners in Los Cabos and La Paz.

## Services
- **Welcome Signs (Letreros de bienvenida):** Large-format custom signs in acrylic, mirror, wood, fabric/linen, and fine paper with calligraphic typography and custom finishes.
- **Seating Charts:** Custom table charts (by table, alphabetical, or family) with on-site delivery and setup.
- **Day-of Stationery (Papelería de mesa):** Coordinated menus, ceremony programs, place cards, table numbers, and vow books.
- **Event Signage (Señalética de evento):** Directional signs, bar menus, timeline boards, and custom event details installed at the venue.

## Service Area
- Los Cabos (Cabo San Lucas & San José del Cabo), Baja California Sur, Mexico
- La Paz, Baja California Sur, Mexico
